segments.an6.62:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena daṇḍakappakaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ nigamo tadavasari.
segments.an6.62:1.3: Atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.an6.62:1.4: Te ca bhikkhū daṇḍakappakaṃ pavisiṃsu āvasathaṃ pariyesituṃ.
segments.an6.62:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena aciravatī nadī tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
segments.an6.62:2.2: Aciravatiyā nadiyā gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
segments.an6.62:2.3: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.62:2.4: “kiṃ nu kho, āvuso ānanda, sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā nu kho devadatto bhagavatā byākato –
segments.an6.62:2.5: ‘āpāyiko devadatto nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho’ti [cūḷava.348; a. ni.8.7 passitabbaṃ], udāhu kenacideva pariyāyenā’ti?
segments.an6.62:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.62:3.2: “idhāhaṃ, bhante, sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena aciravatī nadī tenupasaṅkamiṃ gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
segments.an6.62:3.3: Aciravatiyā nadiyā gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsiṃ gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
segments.an6.62:3.4: Atha kho, bhante, aññataro bhikkhu yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.62:3.5: ‘kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, ānanda sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā nu kho devadatto bhagavatā byākato – āpāyiko devadatto nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekicchoti, udāhu kenacideva pariyāyenā’ti?
segments.an6.62:3.7: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.an6.62:4.1: “So vā [so ca (syā.)] kho, ānanda, bhikkhu navo bhavissati acirapabbajito, thero vā pana bālo abyatto.
segments.an6.62:4.2: Kathañhi nāma yaṃ mayā ekaṃsena byākataṃ tattha dvejjhaṃ āpajjissati!
segments.an6.62:4.3: Nāhaṃ, ānanda, aññaṃ ekapuggalampi samanupassāmi, yo evaṃ mayā sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā byākato, yathayidaṃ devadatto.
segments.an6.62:4.4: Yāvakīvañcāhaṃ, ānanda, devadattassa vālaggakoṭinittudanamattampi sukkadhammaṃ addasaṃ;
segments.an6.62:4.7: Yato ca kho ahaṃ, ānanda, devadattassa vālaggakoṭinittudanamattampi sukkadhammaṃ na addasaṃ;
segments.an6.62:5.1: “Seyyathāpi, ānanda, gūthakūpo sādhikaporiso pūro gūthassa samatittiko.
segments.an6.62:5.3: Tassa kocideva puriso uppajjeyya atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo tamhā gūthakūpā uddharitukāmo.
segments.an6.62:5.4: So taṃ gūthakūpaṃ samantānuparigacchanto neva passeyya tassa purisassa vālaggakoṭinittudanamattampi gūthena amakkhitaṃ, yattha taṃ gahetvā uddhareyya.
segments.an6.62:5.5: Evamevaṃ kho ahaṃ, ānanda, yato devadattassa vālaggakoṭinittudanamattampi sukkadhammaṃ na addasaṃ;
segments.an6.62:5.8: Sace tumhe, ānanda, suṇeyyātha tathāgatassa purisindriyañāṇāni vibhajissāmī”ti [vibhajantassāti (sī. syā. pī.)]?
segments.an6.62:6.1: “Etassa, bhagavā, kālo; etassa, sugata, kālo yaṃ bhagavā purisindriyañāṇāni vibhajeyya.
segments.an6.62:6.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.an6.62:7.1: “Idhāhaṃ, ānanda, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi –
segments.an6.62:7.2: ‘imassa kho puggalassa vijjamānā kusalāpi dhammā akusalāpi dhammā’ti.
segments.an6.62:7.3: Tamenaṃ aparena samayena evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi –
segments.an6.62:7.4: ‘imassa kho puggalassa kusalā dhammā antarahitā, akusalā dhammā sammukhībhūtā.
segments.an6.62:7.5: Atthi ca khvassa kusalamūlaṃ asamucchinnaṃ, tamhā tassa kusalā kusalaṃ pātubhavissati.
segments.an6.62:7.7: Seyyathāpi, ānanda, bījāni akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avātātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni sukhette suparikammakatāya bhūmiyā nikkhittāni.
segments.an6.62:7.8: Jāneyyāsi tvaṃ, ānanda, imāni bījāni vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissantī”ti?

segments.an6.62:7.11: ‘imassa kho puggalassa vijjamānā kusalāpi dhammā akusalāpi dhammā’ti.

segments.an6.62:7.18: Evampi kho, ānanda, tathāgatassa āyatiṃ dhammasamuppādo cetasā ceto paricca vidito hoti.

segments.an6.62:13.2: Tatrānanda, yeme pacchimā tayo puggalā imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ eko parihānadhammo, eko aparihānadhammo, eko parinibbānadhammo”ti.

lines: Idaṃ so “kiṃ nu kho bhagavatā jānitvā kathitaṃ, udāhu ajānitvā, ekaṃsikaṃ vā kathitaṃ udāhu vibhajjakathitan”ti adhippāyena pucchati.
Vijjamānā kusalāpi dhammā akusalāpi dhammāti ettakā kusalā dhammā vijjanti, ettakā akusalā dhammāti jānāmi.
Kusalā kusalanti tamhā kusalajjhāsayā aññampi kusalaṃ nibbattissati.
So hi pāpamittaṃ nissāya maggaphalehi parihīno.
Aṭṭhame nibbattivasena apāyasaṃvattaniyena vā kammunā apāyesu niyuttoti āpāyiko nerayikoti etthāpi eseva nayo.
Avīcimhi uppajjitvā tattha āyukappasaññitaṃ antarakappaṃ tiṭṭhatīti kappaṭṭho.
Bhinnakālato paṭṭhāya bījaṃ bījatthāya na upakappati.
Avātātapahatānīti vātena ca ātapena ca na hatāni nirojataṃ na pāpitāni.
Nirojañhi kasaṭaṃ bījaṃ bījatthāya na upakappati.
“Sārādānī”ti vattabbe ā-kārassa rassattaṃ katvā pāḷiyaṃ “sāradānī”ti vuttanti āha “sārādānī”ti.
Sukhasayitānīti cattāro māse koṭṭhe pakkhittaniyāmeneva sukhasayitāni suṭṭhu sannicitāni.
Puṇṇamāsiyañhi gaganamajjhassa purato vā pacchato vā cande ṭhite aḍḍharattasamayo bhinno nāma hoti, majjhe eva pana ṭhite abhinno nāma.

Suppabuddhasunakkhattādayoti ettha (dha. pa. aṭṭha.2.127 suppabuddhasakyavatthu) suppabuddho kira sākiyo “mama dhītaraṃ chaḍḍetvā nikkhanto, mama puttaṃ pabbājetvā tassa veriṭṭhāne ṭhito cā”ti imehi dvīhi kāraṇehi satthari āghātaṃ bandhitvā ekadivasaṃ “na dāni nimantitaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā bhuñjituṃ dassāmī”ti gamanamaggaṃ pidahitvā antaravīthiyaṃ suraṃ pivanto nisīdi.
Athassa satthari bhikkhusaṅghaparivute taṃ ṭhānaṃ āgate “satthā āgato”ti ārocesuṃ.
“purato gacchāti tassa vadetha, nāyaṃ mayā mahallakataro, nāssa maggaṃ dassāmī”ti.
Satthā mātulassa santikā maggaṃ alabhitvā tatova nivatti.
“ko nu kho, bhante, sitapātukamme paccayo”ti puṭṭho āha –
Bhāriyaṃ tena kammaṃ kataṃ mādisassa buddhassa maggaṃ adentena, ito sattame divase heṭṭhāpāsāde pāsādamūle pathaviyā pavisissatī”ti ācikkhi.
Sunakkhattopi (ma. ni. aṭṭha.1.147) pubbe bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā dibbacakkhuparikammaṃ pucchi.
So dibbacakkhuṃ nibbattetvā ālokaṃ vaḍḍhetvā olokento devaloke nandanavanacittalatāvanaphārusakavanamissakavanesu dibbasampattiṃ anubhavamāne devaputte ca devadhītaro ca disvā –
“etesaṃ evarūpāya attabhāvasampattiyā ṭhitānaṃ kira madhuro nu kho saddo bhavissatī”ti saddaṃ sotukāmo hutvā dasabalaṃ upasaṅkamitvā dibbasotadhātuparikammaṃ pucchi.
“dibbasotadhātussa upanissayo natthī”ti ñatvā parikammaṃ na kathesi.
Na hi buddhā yaṃ na bhavissati, tassa parikammaṃ kathenti.
“ahaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ paṭhamaṃ dibbacakkhuparikammaṃ pucchiṃ, so mayhaṃ ‘sampajjatu vā mā vā sampajjatū’ti kathesi.
Ahaṃ pana paccattapurisakārena taṃ nibbattetvā dibbasotadhātuparikammaṃ pucchiṃ, taṃ me na kathesi.

Addhā evaṃ hoti ‘ayaṃ rājapabbajito dibbacakkhuñāṇaṃ nibbattetvā, dibbasotañāṇaṃ nibbattetvā, cetopariyakammañāṇaṃ nibbattetvā, āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ nibbattetvā, mayā samasamo bhavissatī’ti issāmacchariyavasena mayhaṃ na kathetī”ti bhiyyoso āghātaṃ bandhitvā kāsāyāni chaḍḍetvā gihibhāvaṃ patvāpi na tuṇhībhūto vihāsi.
Dasabalaṃ pana asatā tucchena abbhācikkhitvā apāyūpago ahosi.
“evampi kho, bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto mayā vuccamāno apakkameva imasmā dhammavinayā, yathā taṃ āpāyiko”ti (dī. ni.3.6).
